name: Domino Rounce
description: Domino Rounce is a competitive trick-taking game for 2 to 4 players, played with a double-six set of dominoes. Similar to the card game Rounce, players start with a positive score and compete to reduce it to zero by winning tricks. It features a unique 'dummy' hand and high-penalty mechanics for failing to win tricks.

content.text: Domino Rounce is a competitive trick-taking game for 2 to 4 players, played with a double-six set of dominoes. Similar to the card game Rounce, players start with a positive score and compete to reduce it to zero by winning tricks. It features a unique 'dummy' hand and high-penalty mechanics for failing to win tricks.
Rounce is a German-American variation of the 17th-century game Loo. The domino adaptation was popular in American social clubs in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
Each player receives 5 tiles. A 'dummy' hand of extra tiles is dealt. The player to the right of the dealer turns up a tile to determine the trump suit.
